what_this_is_not: R values are copied from the tracked fixture. Julia values are computed fresh by tools/true_parity_julia_receipts.jl, which repeats the computation of the cited twin test with the same inputs and settings; R was not run and is not recomputed here.

cases.quantity: maximised logLik of the miss_both fit
cases.note: Gaussian, p = 4, n = 120 units (sha256 checked), x NA at 18 units; R: value ~ 0 + trait + mi(x) + latent(0 + trait | unit, d = 1, unique = FALSE), impute = list(x = x ~ z), family = gaussian(), converged with a positive-definite Hessian; Julia: fit_gaussian_mi_fiml(Y, x; K = 1, Z = z), the same model (shared slope on x, covariate model x ~ N(mu_x + gamma z, sigma_x^2), one latent factor, common residual SD) with the missing x integrated out in closed form where R uses the Laplace approximation (exact for this Gaussian model). The sign of a one-axis loading is not identified, so loadings are compared through Lambda Lambda'. 36 response cells NA (column value_na, drawn at random plus one cell of a unit whose x is missing; no unit loses all its responses). R: missing = miss_control(response = "include", predictor = "model"); the response = "drop" fit reaches the same logLik (asserted in the generator). Julia: the same cells as `missing` entries of Y (observed-data likelihood).
